verdict.rationale: Before a run starts, Consensus lets researchers choose a deeper mode via Deep Search, described as "more comprehensive Lit Reviews across many studies". They can also narrow scope with filters for study type, year, journal, open access and discipline, with Medical Mode, and with an exclude-preprints flag. There is no evidence of explicit effort or depth parameters beyond picking a mode, or of steering a run while it executes. Missing for 10: mid-run steering or redirection, granular depth/effort controls (e.g. number of sources or iterations), documentation of how Deep Search depth is configured, independent hands-on corroboration.
